title: Fleet control pane: rate-based scaling presets, previewed throughput SLOs, and immutable change snapshots
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Admins need a single, auditable control surface to configure fleet scaling that guarantees throughput SLOs for dedicated capacity while letting operators preview the live impact before committing. Current console flows expose simple presets but don't show a deterministic SLO preview, lack immutable snapshots for audit, and make rate-based scaling hard to reason about for mixed-latency workloads.

Goal: Build a Fleet Control Pane card that offers: (1) rate-based scaling presets and soft/hard mode toggles, (2) a preview visualization that simulates expected throughput and p95 latency under historical traffic patterns, and (3) an immutable change snapshot recorded to the console change history for compliance and rollback. The feature should support canary/apply flows for Dedicated customers and integrate with existing rollout and fallback policies.

Scope: UX for the control card, backend endpoints to compute SLO previews (simulation), store immutable snapshots, audit log integration, and console telemetry for adoption and regression checks. Not in scope: low-level autoscaler kernel changes and billing model adjustments (handled separately).
acceptance_criteria: UI exposes rate-based scaling presets (min/max tokens/sec per GPU, target utilization) and a soft/hard SLO toggle
Preview panel shows simulated throughput, p95 token latency, and expected cost delta for selected preset using last 7 days of traffic
Submit action creates an immutable change snapshot that appears in Fleet -> Change History with timestamp, author, preset details, and simulation output
API endpoint /fleet/v1/simulation returns deterministic preview given preset and historical window (aggregate-only) and is rate-limited
Canary rollout flow: ability to apply preset to a subset of nodes and auto-fallback on latency or error regressions
Telemetry emitted for applied presets, preview runs, and rollback events (console:presets.apply, console:presets.preview, console:presets.rollback)
Role check: only users with fleet.write or fleet.admin role can commit changes; others see preview-only
Automated test coverage for UI interactions and simulation endpoint contract (contract tests pass)
Performance: preview computation returns within 4s for 7-day window on typical infra snapshot
